The woman is holding an open makeup palette with the word 'Contour' written above it. She is using a brush to pick up product from the palette, showing contour application.
The woman is applying a product to her cheek with her fingers, likely blush.
The woman is holding a red tube with a wand applicator, which appears to be a lip product.
